id: title:danielxnj:move the lifecycle fence off the hot organization row

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces database contention and potential deadlocks on the shared Organization table by moving warehouse lifecycle operations to a dedicated lifecycle row, while retaining row-level locking on that lifecycle row.
review.reason: The observed change replaces a shared row-level lock on the Organization table with a dedicated lifecycle row fence, reducing contention and potential deadlocks. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and complete implementation context are not fully demonstrated; the tier is assigned based solely on the observed hunk, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No PR metadata, release notes, or adoption figures are supplied, so tier assignment and benefit claims remain unverified.

observations.behavior: Replaces the organization row's FOR UPDATE with a lifecycle row fence; the lifecycle row is selected with select_for_update while the organization row is read-only.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces contention on the shared Organization table by serializing warehouse lifecycle operations on a dedicated lifecycle row instead of the hot Organization row, while retaining row-level locking on the lifecycle row.
